tutorialNotes.title: GIVE IT A REASON
tutorialNotes.body: One wants to race. One wants to cross together.
tutorialNotes.command: Choose a goal before a move.

tutorialNotes.title: LET A REPLY MATTER
tutorialNotes.body: Tails speaks. Sonic changes his next move.

tutorialNotes.title: DIRECT THE ATTEMPT
tutorialNotes.body: Aim for a destination. Let native movement do the work.

tutorialNotes.title: WAIT FOR THE RESULT
tutorialNotes.body: Let the landing finish before the next instruction.
